entities.summary: Polad Bulbuloghlu is a Soviet and Azerbaijani singer, actor, politician, and diplomat. Bulbuloghlu became famous in the Soviet Union with composing jazz-influenced songs with heavy Azerbaijani folk influences in Azerbaijani and Russian languages. He also sang his own songs. Three of his songs became Songs of the Year and he received numerous prestigious awards in the Soviet Union. Bulbuloghlu is a lyrical tenor. Polad Bulbuloghlu was a political leaders from Baku (b. 1945-02-04, Baku). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
